title: Gemini streaming drops native web search option
reasoning: Gemini implements _open_stream to append the google_search tool when native_web_search_enabled is present, but the shared OnlineLLMProvider._stream_internal does not call _open_stream. It instead rebuilds request params from _extract_request_options, whose allowlist does not include native_web_search_enabled, and streams those params directly. As a result, Gemini non-streaming requests can enable native web search, while Gemini streaming requests silently omit the google_search tool.
recommendation: Route the shared streaming path through _open_stream, or include native_web_search_enabled in Gemini's streaming request construction path and pass the resulting params to the stream handler. Keep this scoped so other providers do not start accepting unsupported request options accidentally.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included test file only checks apply_provider_native_thinking_request_params. There is no Gemini streaming test that passes native_web_search_enabled and asserts the emitted LiteLLM params include the google_search tool.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a GeminiProvider streaming test with litellm.acompletion mocked, call the stream path with native_web_search_enabled=True, and assert the request tools include {'google_search': {}}.
